jei.mnogii.mask.info: Kanohi Mata masks. Craft in a Mask Forge. Cosmetic when worn.
jei.mnogii.mask_forge.info: Crafting station. Used to craft Kanohi masks. Recipe: Onu Wahi Stone (corners), Protodermis Ingot (top center), Iron Ingots, Lava Bucket (center), Obsidian (bottom center).
jei.mnogii.heatstone_lighter.info: The Heatstone Lighter is a durable fire-starter forged from Ta-Koro heatstone. It recharges automatically while carried in the Nether Wastes.
jei.mnogii.disc.info: Throwable Kanoka discs. Bamboo Disc: craft from 4 Bamboo (2x2). Kanoka Disc: craft from Clay + Gold Nugget + Lapis Lazuli (shapeless).
jei.mnogii.disc.koro.info: Koro-specific Kanoka disks. Traded from Matoran Disc Crafters. Each disk is aligned to a Koro's elemental energy.
jei.mnogii.toa_weapons.info: Elemental weapons wielded by the six Toa Mata, forged from protodermis. Each weapon channels a Toa's elemental power. Dropped by the Toa when defeated.
jei.mnogii.protodermis_tools.info: Tools forged from Protodermis Ingots. Equivalent in durability and power to diamond tools.
jei.mnogii.armor.fire.info: Tahu's armored set, forged from fire-tempered protodermis. Provides iron-equivalent protection. Dropped by Tahu when defeated.
jei.mnogii.armor.water.info: Gali's armored set, forged from water-blessed protodermis. Provides iron-equivalent protection. Dropped by Gali when defeated.
jei.mnogii.armor.air.info: Lewa's armored set, forged from wind-light protodermis. Provides iron-equivalent protection. Dropped by Lewa when defeated.
jei.mnogii.armor.earth.info: Onua's armored set, forged from earth-hardened protodermis. Provides iron-equivalent protection. Dropped by Onua when defeated.
jei.mnogii.armor.ice.info: Kopaka's armored set, forged from ice-cold protodermis. Provides iron-equivalent protection. Dropped by Kopaka when defeated.
jei.mnogii.armor.stone.info: Pohatu's armored set, forged from stone-tough protodermis. Provides iron-equivalent protection. Dropped by Pohatu when defeated.

dialogue.mnogii.matoran.greeting: Hello, traveler. The Great Spirit guides us all. Have you come to help protect Mata Nui?
dialogue.mnogii.turaga.greeting: Welcome, friend. I am a Turaga, elder of this land. Speak with me when you wish to trade or learn of the old ways.
